How many ZIP code areas reach into Kings County, New York?
SELECT count(DISTINCT geoid_zcta5_20) AS zip_areas FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_zcta520_county20 WHERE geoid_county_20 = '36047'
Which large cities have the highest median rents?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_gross_rent FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '1600000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b25064' AND a.variable = 'B25064_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many clinicians are affiliated with dialysis facilities?
SELECT count(DISTINCT npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.cc_facility_affiliation WHERE facility_type = 'Dialysis facility'
Which federal programs accounted for the most spending in 2023 single audits?

SELECT federal_program_name, sum(try_cast(amount_expended AS double)) AS expended FROM govblock_executive.fac_federal_awards WHERE audit_year = '2023' AND federal_program_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of ChEMBL compounds break none of Lipinski's rule-of-five limits?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN num_ro5_violations = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_compound_properties
Are EPA enforcement cases mostly administrative or judicial?
SELECT activity_type_desc, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_case_enforcements WHERE activity_type_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was U.S. gross domestic product in 2024, in current dollars?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS gdp_millions FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_nipadataa WHERE seriescode = 'A191RC' AND period = '2024'
Which states fill the most antibiotic prescriptions under Medicare Part D?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Geography And Drug

SELECT prscrbr_geo_desc AS state, sum(try_cast(tot_clms AS double)) AS antibiotic_claims FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_geo_lvl = 'State' AND antbtc_drug_flag = 'Y' AND source_file = (SELECT max(source_file) FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_geography_and_drug) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of 2023 mortgage applications were to buy a home, refinance or borrow against equity?

SELECT CASE cast(loan_purpose AS varchar) WHEN '1' THEN 'home purchase' WHEN '2' THEN 'home improvement' WHEN '4' THEN 'other purpose' WHEN '31' THEN 'refinancing' WHEN '32' THEN 'cash-out refinancing' ELSE 'not applicable' END AS purpose, count(*) AS applications, round(100.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What products are sold under wholesale electricity contracts?
SELECT product_name, count(*) AS contract_lines FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_contracts WHERE year_quarter LIKE '2024%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of trademark registrations cancelled change from 2010 to 2024?
SELECT substr(reg_cancel_dt, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS cancelled FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE substr(reg_cancel_dt, 1, 4) IN ('2010', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which industry codes are listed most often as the primary business of SAM.gov registrants?
SELECT primary_naics, count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of U.S. exports went by air in 2019?

SELECT round(100.0 * max(try_cast(air_val_yr AS double)) / max(try_cast(all_val_yr AS double)), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_cty WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2019' AND month = '12' AND cty_name = 'TOTAL FOR ALL COUNTRIES'
Which power plants still run the oldest generators?
SELECT plant_name, state, min(try_cast(operating_year AS integer)) AS oldest_unit FROM govblock_energy.eia860_generator_y_sheet_operable WHERE status = 'OP' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 ASC LIMIT 10
How have consumer prices in the New York metro area risen year by year?
SELECT year, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_cu_data WHERE series_id = 'CUURS12ASA0' AND period = 'M13' ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 10
What did the Department of Health and Human Services spend the most on in contracts in fiscal 2024?

SELECT product_or_service_code_description, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE cast(action_date_fiscal_year AS varchar) = '2024' AND upper(awarding_agency_name) = 'DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES' AND product_or_service_code_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Do more inventors on U.S. applications come from Japan or from Germany?
SELECT inventor_country_code, count(*) AS inventors FROM govblock_patents.patex_inventors_25 WHERE inventor_country_code IN ('JP', 'DE') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
What types of patent application are filed most, regular, provisional, reissue or reexamination?
SELECT application_type, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.patex_application_data_25 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the median home purchase loan in 2023?

SELECT approx_percentile(try_cast(loan_amount AS double), 0.5) AS median_loan FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1' AND cast(loan_purpose AS varchar) = '1'
Which service occupations get the highest Service Contract Act wage rates?
SELECT occupation_title, round(avg(try_cast(rate AS double)), 2) AS avg_rate FROM govblock_awards.sam_wd_sca_rates GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 50 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many GAO reports were published in 1999?
SELECT count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'GAO' AND date LIKE '1999%'
Which health and welfare rates appear most often in service contract wage determinations?
SELECT health_welfare, count(*) AS determinations FROM govblock_awards.sam_wage_determinations WHERE kind = 'sca' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many active participants did large plans report for plan year 2000?
SELECT sum(try_cast(tot_active_partcp_cnt AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_5500 WHERE substr(form_plan_year_begin_date, 1, 4) = '2000'
Which laws account for the most Judgment Fund payments?

SELECT principal_citation_desc, sum(try_cast(confirmed_payment_amt AS double)) AS paid FROM govblock_treasury.jfics_congress_report WHERE principal_citation_desc IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many rules did the EPA list in the spring 2024 regulatory agenda?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rin) AS rules FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE publication_id = '202404' AND acronym LIKE '%EPA%'
Which grid operators exported the most electricity to their neighbours in 2023?
SELECT balancing_authority, sum(try_cast(interchange_mw AS double)) AS net_export_mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_interchange WHERE data_date LIKE '%/2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many petroleum terminals can receive crude oil by ship?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_petroleum_terminals WHERE marine_in = 'YES' AND crude_oil = 'YES'
Which California cities appear most often as inventor locations on granted patents?
SELECT raw_city, count(*) AS locations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_location_not_disambiguated WHERE raw_country = 'US' AND raw_state = 'CA' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many hospital cost reports from 1995 are in the library?
SELECT count(DISTINCT rpt_rec_num) AS reports FROM govblock_health.hcris_hosp_nmrc WHERE hcris_fy = '1995'
How are insiders related to the companies whose stock they report?
SELECT rptowner_relationship, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_reportingowner GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of medical device reports involve an injury rather than a malfunction?
SELECT event_type, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_health.fda_device_event GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which counties have the largest Hispanic citizen voting-age population?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_county WHERE lntitle = 'Hispanic or Latino' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of audited federal awards are tested as major programs?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN upper(substr(cast(is_major AS varchar), 1, 1)) = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_executive.fac_federal_awards
Which ERCOT buses carry the highest average day-ahead prices in the bus price records?
Ercot Lmp By Bus Dam Cdr Damhrlmpnp
SELECT busname, avg(try_cast(lmp AS double)) AS dollars_per_mwh FROM govblock_solar.ercot_lmp_by_bus_dam_cdr_damhrlmpnp WHERE busname IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many papers are indexed under Alzheimer Disease?
SELECT count(DISTINCT pmid) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_mesh WHERE descriptor_name = 'Alzheimer Disease'
Which states have the highest share of homes standing vacant?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B25002_E003' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B25002_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_vacant FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b25002' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of working residents of the Bronx earned $1,250 a month or less in 2019?

SELECT sum(ce01) AS low_wage, sum(c000) AS all_workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_rac WHERE state = 'ny' AND segment = 'S000' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2019 AND substr(h_geocode, 1, 5) = '36005'
Which agencies have sent the most rules to the White House regulatory office for review?

SELECT a.name AS agency, count(*) AS reviews FROM govblock_executive.oira_eo_reviews_completed e JOIN govblock_executive.oira_agy_agency_list a ON a.agency_code = e.agency_code GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
